description.from:
Part of the scheduled publishing and announcements epic. Design: docs/plans/scheduled-publishing-and-announcements.md ("Cost control").

Goal: a site never spends more on X than its owner allowed, sees what it has spent, and gets a budget suggestion from its own pace; no fixed numbers in code.

Shape: per-site settings: prices (copied from docs.x.com pricing with their date; verified 2026-11-12: post with link $0.200, post $0.015, delete $0.010, read $0.005) and budget per X billing cycle (required, no default, with the owner's reason); a spend counter row per account per cycle incremented once per post, delete or read with the price used; before each paid call, counter + price > budget -> `blocked: budget reached` and pause with that reason; suggestion = the site's own rate of eligible Stories (counted once per eligibility event) x price per post; X's daily usage counts (`GET /2/usage/tweets`) shown beside our counter; the owner told to set X's console spending limit.

Depends on: the channel framework story.

```gherkin
Feature: Announcements never cost more than the owner allowed
  Every post with a link costs money at X. The owner sets the budget and can always
  see the spend.

  Scenario: No budget, no announcements
    Given an owner who has not entered a budget
    When the owner tries to turn announcements on
    Then the page asks for a budget for each X billing cycle first

  Scenario: Spend is counted per post
    Given a price of $0.20 per post with a link
    When three announcements are posted this cycle
    Then the page shows "$0.60 spent of $10.00 this cycle"

  Scenario: Reaching the budget pauses
    Given $9.90 spent of a $10.00 budget
    When an announcement is due
    Then it is not posted
    And announcements pause with "Budget reached for this cycle"
    And the waiting Story is listed as "Blocked: budget reached"

  Scenario: A new cycle or a bigger budget resumes
    Given announcements paused for budget
    When the owner raises the budget to $20.00
    Then the waiting announcement posts

  Scenario: A budget suggestion from our own pace
    Given MoM had 4 Stories meet its announcement rules in the last two months
    Then the page suggests "At your pace, about 2 posts and $0.40 per month"

  Scenario: Our count and X's count side by side
    Then the page shows our post count and X's own usage count for the same days
    And says where they differ
```

Open questions: the budget for MoM (recommend Ryan enters one; a few dollars covers today's pace many times over).
